scenario.name: r-cd-model-default
scenario.description: Default provider/model inheritance for continue_delegate tool and bracket/token forms when no override is supplied.
scenario.registryNotes: Local scratch conversion: runnable k6 scenario covers typed continue_delegate no-model override default inheritance; bracket no-model remains review gap unless separately added.

invocation.promptTemplate: MDEF:{{nonceSuffix16}} Proof nonce {{nonce}}: reply exactly MODEL-DEFAULT-CHILD {{nonce}} MODEL <provider/model>, replacing <provider/model> with the current model identity from runtime context. Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the parent request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate for this model row

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-observed
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-correlated delegate child session/run is observed on the subscribed session stream or session history

expectedReceipts.name: child-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Child SERVED provider/model from the row-bound assistant message in the child's own chat.history inside the row run window (after the row anchor, first message carrying the row sentinel; stopReason recorded). sessions.describe model/modelProvider is recorded separately as the persisted SELECTION and alone yields PARTIAL (selection matched; served route unproven). Active fallback or a mixed served window is FAIL (#561/#562 review). The child self-report is auxiliary and never used for equality (#559).

expectedReceipts.name: return-payload
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return includes the row nonce and observed model/provider summary

expectedReceipts.name: trace-or-session-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Trace id, span tree, or session-event correlation tying dispatch to child and return

expectedReceipts.name: parent-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Parent SERVED provider/model: the parent's own chat.history assistant message carrying MODEL-DEFAULT-PARENT-SCHEDULED <nonce> after the dispatch message is the inheritance baseline; the parent sessions.describe selection is recorded alongside. Optional OPENCLAW_EXPECTED_MODEL pins the served baseline; a wrong pin is the negative control (FAIL).

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace JSON (tempo-trace-<id>.json) for the continue_delegate tool → continuation.delegate.dispatch → continuation.delegate.fire topology, collected by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. Required for every continuation row (#600).

expectedReceipts.name: continuation-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: continuation-trace-correlation.json: exactly one Tempo trace matched by the row’s reason hash, length, and delegate mode, holding one continuation.delegate.dispatch span, one continuation.delegate.fire span, and the originating continue_delegate tool span on one trace and chain.

review.notes: PASS-candidate only when both tool and bracket/token no-override forms produce child sessions whose model/provider matches the parent baseline. This is the contrast row for explicit override rows.

census.limits: The census found accepted continuation entry spans carry no origin, session, turn, or run identity and that proof traffic carries no marker, so this row’s trace receipt joins the continue_delegate tool span to continuation.delegate.dispatch and continuation.delegate.fire only by shared trace, causal timing, and the reason fingerprint and mode. This row’s verdict rests on gateway transcripts, not telemetry: the census established that an accepted entry span cannot be joined to the child run it produced, so the trace cannot corroborate which child inherited which model. The trace receipts record review completeness only.

spans.name: continuation.delegate.dispatch
spans.notes: Accepted entry span. Carries no origin/session/turn/run identity.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed continue_delegate evidence. Joined to the dispatch span only by shared trace and causal timing.

spans.name: openclaw.model.call
spans.notes: Model-call spans exist fleet-wide; they cannot be attributed to a specific continuation entry.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and asserted by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: Model and provider identifiers are published literally because they are public product identifiers. Delegate task material is published only as a digest and a length; prompt bodies, raw nonces, raw session keys, and tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: With no model override, the child’s served provider/model in its own transcript equals the parent’s served baseline.
controls.negative: A wrong OPENCLAW_EXPECTED_MODEL pin fails the row, and child prose is never used for model equality.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded or empty Tempo answer leaves tempo-trace-json and its correlation receipt pending. That is review debt, not evidence that the continuation did not happen, and it never changes the VU verdict.

verdictAuthority.pass: The child’s run-window-bound served model equals the parent’s served baseline. Behavioral only; the trace receipts decide review completeness, not the verdict.
verdictAuthority.partial: Only the persisted selection matched, authoritative transcripts are unavailable, or a required receipt is missing. A missing or degraded trace keeps the row review-pending without changing its class.
verdictAuthority.fail: The child serves a different model than the parent baseline, including an active fallback.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cd-model-default.js fires the typed continue_delegate with no model and reads both transcripts.
execution.manual: Manual runs may confirm the parent baseline on a seat before the row is fired; they are never evidence.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row owns the verdict. The Tempo trace receipts decide only whether review is complete; manual review corroborates topology and never upgrades a missing receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Default model inheritance row. This scratch scenario covers typed-tool no-model path; manifest review originally asks both typed and bracket forms, so fold should decide whether this is full row or typed-subcase only.
